newsitem.title: USA: Emery Worldwide lands 5yr 3M logistics pact.
newsitem.headline: Emery Worldwide lands 5yr 3M logistics pact.

text.p: Emery Worldwide said it has been awarded a further five year multimillion dollar contract to serve as one of 3M Corp's preferred domestic air freight carriers for shipments of 150 pounds or more above.
Emery will handle door-to-door delivery of U.S. shipments, moving freight between 3M's manufacturing and distribution facilities as well as between supplier and customer bases.
The majority of shipments for 3M will require overnight delivery to and from the company's 250 locations throughout the United States. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
